fields.statement: Beyond the named case and the version rule the harness found no other interim-side case: with the interim model built from the strict views, TestPropertyProjectionParity passes at the default checks and at -rapid.checks=1000 with every known case restricted to the index side. The two interim entries (Pending of an op before the target's create, and branches applied depth first in op ID order) are removed; the rest now name the index's write model, for parity-write-index-from-strict.
